table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale' else item.name end, 
	altersaleinvcode=max(saleledger.altersaleinvcode),
	users.username,  
	salecat=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	saletypename=(select name from saletype where max(saleledger.saletypecode)=saletype.saletypecode),
	custref=max(saleledger.custrefno),
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	custalias=accounts.aliasname,
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,
	custcity=max(customer.city), 
	custntnno=customer.ntnno,  
    custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	saleperson=(select  name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=saleledger.smancode), 
	headerinvno=max(saleledger.headerinvno),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	serverdate=getdate(),
	dbo.saleledger.date,
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.advancetaxamt,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.FBRPOSFee,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	gcode=max(dbo.saledetail.gcode), 
	cashreceived=max(dbo.saleledger.cashreceived),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty),
	bonusqty =  sum(saledetail.bonusqty),
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	Batch = saledetail.batch,
	Expiry = saledetail.Expiry,
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	itemgstperc=MAX(saledetail.gstperc),
	SalesTaxSchedule_prec = (SELECT MAX(STS.taxperc) FROM SalesTaxSchedule STS WHERE STS.SalesTaxScheduleCode = Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode),
	TaxType = (SELECT MAX(STS.TaxType) FROM SalesTaxSchedule STS WHERE STS.SalesTaxScheduleCode = Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode),
	itemunitsalestax=saledetail.unitsalestax,
	discperc  = max(case when saledetail.discperc > 0 then saledetail.discperc else saledetail.clonediscperc end), 
	clonediscperc=saledetail.clonediscperc,
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc = max(case when saledetail.itemflatdisc > 0 then saledetail.itemflatdisc else saledetail.cloneitemflatdisc end), 
	cloneitemflatdisc=saledetail.cloneitemflatdisc,
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(saleledger.machinename),
	totaltaxonInv=dbo.fn_gettaxonsaleinv(saleledger.saleinvcode),
	fiscalinvoiceno = saleledger.fiscalinvoiceno,
	cashtendered=max(saleledger.cashtendered),
	cashcharged=max(saleledger.cashcharged),
	InvTotal = max(saleledger.InvTotal),
	CardCharged=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode=:ra_InvCode),0),
	PreviousLoyalty = 
		ISNULL((SELECT PL=SUM(LC.PointsDebit - LC.PointsCredit) 
		FROM LoyaltyCardLedger LC 
		WHERE 
			LC.AccCode = dbo.saleledger.custcode AND 
			ISNULL(LC.InvoiceType,'') + STR(ISNULL(LC.InvoiceCode,0)) <> 'SV' + STR(dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode)), 0),
	PointsAdded = 
		ISNULL((SELECT PL=SUM(LC.PointsDebit - LC.PointsCredit) 
		FROM LoyaltyCardLedger LC 
		WHERE LC.AccCode = dbo.saleledger.custcode AND LC.InvoiceType = 'SV' AND LC.InvoiceCode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode), 0),
	TotalLoyalty = 
		ISNULL((SELECT PL=SUM(LC.PointsDebit - LC.PointsCredit) 
		FROM LoyaltyCardLedger LC 
		WHERE LC.AccCode = dbo.saleledger.custcode), 0),
		reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter)
FROM dbo.saleledger,   
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item,
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	Users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	accounts.aliasname,
	dbo.customer.address1,   
	dbo.customer.address2, 
	customer.salestaxregno  ,
	customer.ntnno,  
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks, 
	saleledger.smancode,
	saleledger.fiscalinvoiceno,
	dbo.saleledger.advancetaxamt,   
	dbo.saleledger.FBRPOSFee, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	saledetail.icode, 
	saledetail.saleprice,
	saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	saledetail.cloneitemflatdisc,
	saledetail.discperc,
	saledetail.clonediscperc,
	saledetail.gstperc,
	saledetail.unitsalestax,
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.customicode,
	Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode,
	saledetail.batch,
	saledetail.expiry,
	users.username
ORDER BY MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: compute_25
objects.expression: if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', (saledetail_rate - cloneitemflatdisc) * (1 - clonediscperc * 0.01) , (saledetail_saleprice - itemflatdisc) * (1 - saledetail_discperc * 0.01))

objects.name: compute_24
objects.expression: (looseqty * itemflatdisc) + (looseqty * ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E' or TaxType='I', saledetail_rate, saledetail_saleprice) - itemflatdisc) * (saledetail_discperc * 0.01))

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)

objects.name: c_salestaxval

objects.visible: 1	if(SUM((looseqty * itemflatdisc) + (looseqty * ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', saledetail_rate, saledetail_saleprice) - itemflatdisc) * (saledetail_discperc * 0.01)) for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum (  c_amount for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )=0,0,1)

objects.name: t_10

objects.expression: SUM((looseqty * itemflatdisc) + (looseqty * ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E' or TaxType='I', saledetail_rate, saledetail_saleprice) - itemflatdisc) * (saledetail_discperc * 0.01)) for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum (  c_amount for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )

objects.name: compute_20
objects.expression: totaltaxoninv - Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01),2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc1  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: compute_26
objects.expression: sum((looseqty * saledetail_rate) +(looseqty *  (saledetail_rate - itemflatdisc) * (1 - saledetail_discperc * 0.01) * itemgstperc * 0.01) for all)

objects.name: compute_19
objects.expression: sum((looseqty * saledetail_rate) +(looseqty *  (saledetail_rate - itemflatdisc) * (1 - saledetail_discperc * 0.01) * itemgstperc * 0.01) for all)

objects.name: compute_17
objects.expression: sum( (looseqty * saledetail_saleprice - if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', 0, looseqty * itemflatdisc)) * (1 - ( if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', 0, saledetail_discperc) * 0.01)) + round( c_amount * itemgstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * itemunitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (looseqty * (saledetail_saleprice - if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', 0, itemflatdisc)))  *  ( 1 -  ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', 0, saledetail_discperc) * 0.01))

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: (looseqty * saledetail_saleprice - if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', 0, looseqty * itemflatdisc)) * (1 - ( if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', 0, saledetail_discperc) * 0.01)) + round( c_amount * itemgstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * itemunitsalestax ,2)
